snippet.title: Trailer Rose Academy #visualnovel #indiegame
snippet.description: Rose Academy is a detective visual novel about a young special agent sent to an elite girls' school to investigate the mysterious death of one of its top students. As you uncover the dark secrets hidden behind the academy’s flawless facade, you'll be drawn into a world of intrigue, temptation, and romance.
